title: Crispy Uruguayan-Style Empanadas with Aromatic Fillings
description: A Japanese twist on traditional Uruguayan empanadas, with crispy fried pastry and aromatic fillings.
instructions: Combine flour and water in a bowl to make the dough. Knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk. Place a tablespoon of daikon filling in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape. Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Fry the empanadas until golden brown.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels. Brush with aromatic soy sauce.
Sprinkle sesame seeds on top of the empanadas before serving.
